**OUR COMPANY – MURPHY \& ASSOCIATES** 




 Murphy \& Associates has had the privilege of providing technology and business consulting services to over 150 diverse clients in the Greater Seattle Area since 1980\. We take great pride in our full disclosure model and low margins which attracts top tier talent. We are transparent with our employees. Our business model fosters loyalty, satisfaction, and consistent delivery of quality services from the consultants on our team. Through it all, Murphy \& Associates has stayed true to its roots, partnering with highly qualified technology and business consultants and working closely with our clients, fairly and ethically.
 



  





**THE CLIENT** 




 The client is a large retail company.
 



  





**QUALITY ENGINEER** 




**Test Cases written in the following languages:** 



* JavaScript, C\# (.NET), Python, SpecFlow and RestClient. Candidates with strong experience in other languages and a good understanding of object\-oriented concepts are also acceptable.



  





**Tools used:** 



* Postman – For API testing.
* Python.
* C\# .NET frameworks, SpecFlow, and RestClient – For test automation.
* SQL Server – For database validation and queries ● Cosmos DB – For scalable, NoSQL database management.
* Azure DevOps (ADO) – For managing the project lifecycle, CI/CD pipelines, and test cases.



  





**YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE** 




**QA Skills and Experience:** 



* 8\+ years’ experience in backend testing using RestClient, C\#, Python, SpecFlow, Postman, and JavaScript.
* Proficient in writing complex SQL queries for data validation.
* Expertise in functional, integration, load/stress, and regression testing.
* Strong collaboration with development teams to ensure seamless test automation integration into the CI/CD pipeline.
* Hands\-on experience in API testing using Postman.
* Maintaining and enhancing C\# testing frameworks.
* Skilled in working with YAML files to create and update test pipelines.
* Utilizing Azure services for debugging and monitoring.
* Experience with CI/CD tools and Agile methodologies.
* Strong background in performance testing using JMeter and LoadRunner.
* Deep understanding of the Payment Domain.
* Proficiency in Azure or GCP cloud services.



  





**WORK ENVIRONMENT** 




**Duration:** 
 ASAP start, run through 8/29/2027, and chance to extend.
 



**Daily Schedule:** 
 M\-F. 40 hours a week, no OT anticipated.
 



**Location:** 
 Hybrid, Issaquah, WA.
 



**Hardware:** 
 Client will provide all necessary hardware.
 



**Submittal/Onboarding requirements:** 
 Client requires a background check \& drug screen before start.
 



  





**BENEFITS** 




 We offer the opportunity to participate in health, dental, and vision insurance, along with a 401k.
 



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




 Please register your interest by applying here with your LinkedIn profile.
 



  





**KEYWORDS** 




*Quality engineer, javascript, C\#, backend testing, test automation CI/CD pipeline*
